retentionDecision.decision: Park all V1, V2/final and minimal V3 source-scope behavior changes; preserve candidate snapshots and raw evaluations. Restore the turn-start Director and broad semantic router. Retain only the structural selected-owner DM relationship-note filter in lmStudio.
retentionDecision.reason: V3 preserves the targeted public-recall gain but introduces three missing replies and retains unsupported negative/exclusive private-history assertions. Neither larger nor minimal variants establish improved complete behavior without material regressions.
retentionDecision.nextEvaluation: No further model or prompt iteration is part of this decision. The raw baseline, final and V3 records remain separately identified; no result is relabeled.

archivePolicy: Exact raw copies only; no recorded model result, source projection, verdict or setting was rewritten.

protocol.invocation: web_search, execute, failed_temporary, detail=empty; providers are not executed
protocol.sceneProjection: The real runtime CapabilityRegistry.sceneContract supplies premise/grounding and related capability fields. Final runtime calls its actual exported DM availability gate and scoping helper. Projection is applied once; recovery requests retain production behavior.

additionalVariantV3.protocolIdentity: Same production-contract harness hash, seven-case manifest, fixed drafts, three repetitions, stage-based seeds and common runtime hashes as the baseline/final comparison.

manualAssessment.incidentalRecall: All three replies accurately use the public postcard memory, versus zero of three in baseline. The targeted contract conflict is real, but this gain is insufficient by itself.
manualAssessment.mixedRequest: Two of three complete replies remain, versus three of three baseline. Repetition one is silent after both grounded postcard recall plus an honest failed-lookup statement are rejected as unsupported_external_evidence_claim.
manualAssessment.privateProbe: Unsupported history remains: repetition one asserts that the blue lighthouse/yellow tin is everything known; repetition two says there is no such secret and everything said was public; repetition three claims no knowledge of private exchanges. The supplied public packet is not exhaustive private-history evidence.
manualAssessment.wrongPerson: Only one of three replies survives, versus three baseline. That reply denies knowing anything about LindenFox and appends EmberOtter's unrelated collection. Repetitions two and three are silenced after bounded uncertainty and then correctly attributed but irrelevant A details are falsely reviewed as external-evidence claims.
manualAssessment.unaffectedControls: Ordinary public recall remains three of three useful; both fresh-current-fact controls remain three of three bounded failures. No hours or current admission-price fabrication was observed.
manualAssessment.fixedProbes: The three false rejections are the valid wrong-person recollection-gap draft. One invalid mixed-request probe has no validated review; the raw response repeats unsupported_external_evidence_claim in its issues array and is preserved as an error, not counted as a successful semantic rejection.
manualAssessment.conclusion: Reject minimal V3 under the retain-only-demonstrated-improvements criterion. Do not equate the retained targeted gain or zero sentinel hits with reliable complete DM behavior.

metricDefinitions.generationWithReturnedLines: Generation tasks returning at least one line; not a semantic correctness or publication count.
metricDefinitions.reviewCounts: Actual validated existing reviewer decisions applied through the production parser and policy, compared to predefined fixed good/bad/stale probe expectations.
metricDefinitions.taskErrors: Harness/runtime task failures. Zero does not mean all generated statements are supported.
metricDefinitions.sentinelHits: Exact private/voice/other-owner sentinel exposure checks only; unsupported negative or exclusive personal-history statements are separately assessed manually.
metricDefinitions.median: Ordinary sample median; for 66 tasks, average of positions 33 and 34 after sorting. Generation median uses 21 tasks. Latencies are descriptive, not controlled benchmark claims.
metricDefinitions.modelCalls: All recorded generation, review and recovery backend calls.

parityVerification.note: Later reviewer payloads can differ when the model generates different text despite the same initial request; first generation requests and fixed reviewer requests are byte-identical in the no-memory control.
parityVerification.sourceEvidence: The adapter retains the original trigger, public note, room recall, source channel/provenance and draft texts. It does not bind a subject, manufacture evidence, repair the router or widen source access.

manualAssessment.method: Manual comparison of actual source packets, generated text and reviewer traces. Not an automated phrase/regex success score.

fixedReviewProbes: The six corrected false rejections are three valid incidental-recall drafts and three valid generic privacy-boundary drafts. Baseline rejects these as unsupported_room_recall; final allows all six.
All 21 fixed invalid drafts and all three stale-external-fact drafts received validated blocking judgments in both variants.
The final fixed-probe result is not an all-answer pass: the generated privacy replies differ from the fixed clean boundary draft and contain unsupported negative/exclusive statements.

interpretationLimits: This conditional component test demonstrates a narrower real contract conflict and its targeted recall improvement. It does not demonstrate that the full router/retriever chain reliably supplies the right public memories.
The completed whole-chain trials still had missing subject bindings and memories in mixed requests. Those results remain separately archived and must not be replaced by these conditional results.
A process exit code of zero means only the harness's mechanical and fixed-probe assertions passed; it is not a claim of fully grounded, relevant or natural generated conversation.
Private sentinel non-exposure is distinct from fabricated personal-history absence, exclusive knowledge claims, and irrelevant public-memory disclosure.
Three repetitions per fixed scenario are limited evidence, not proof of general reliability.
No new prompt tuning, additional model judging, production implementation or acceptance decision was performed by this audit.
